raw_proposal.draft:
Hi [Customer Name],

Thank you for your inquiry. We understand that your facilities management team is currently exploring options and has not yet identified a specific requirement or project owner. To help move things forward, we recommend scheduling a discovery meeting to clarify your needs and establish integration requirements.

Our team is ready to assist you in this process. Please let us know a convenient time to arrange the meeting.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Contact Information]
